positions.title: Technology Assessment Engineer
positions.description:
•	Assessed applications and benefits of new technology on the distribution system and customer enhancement projects.
•	Provided cost/benefit estimates and data analyses for integration of smart grid technology on existing systems.
•	Collaborated with engineers and vendors to develop new technology for reliability improvements. 
•	Wrote white papers on new and existing power electronics technology for distribution within Ameren Illinois.
•	Managed Ameren Illinois electric vehicle fleet and related technology.

positions.title: ECE Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted in the grading, preparation, and record keeping of projects and assignments in the ECE351 Signals and Systems lab due to expertise with MATLAB.
•	Met with students during office hours to provide help on assignments.
•	Graded homework assignments for ECE420 Auto Control Systems and ECE310 Electric Energy Conversion.

positions.title: Service Desk Technician
positions.description:
•	Used real-time thinking and problem solving skills to troubleshoot computer and network problems.
•	Entrusted with administrative rights due to a professional commitment to leadership and integrity.
•	Skilled at providing technical support and explaining technical information to non-technical customers in an easy to understand manner.
•	Performed hardware and software support and installation to satisfy customer needs.
•	Created training documents and provided training to new hires.

positions.title: Production Studio Director
positions.description:
•	Oversaw the production and mixing of audio recordings from start to finish.
•	Operated a sound board and sound equipment while recording.
•	Managed and trained a three person team in the recording studio on equipment and software used for audio recording and mastering.

positions.title: Process Control Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
•	Designed human machine interfaces via Wonderware InTouch and PI 
•	Organized documents regarding existing Allen-Bradley PLC systems and data in preparation of upgrade projects.
•	Coordinated and collaborated with a team of engineers on a plant twin-caster upgrade project.
•	Assisted in troubleshooting of Control Logix PLC ladder logic.
•	Developed a network interface for data collected via Kepware OPC Server in Microsoft Visual C#.

honors.title: Saint Louis University Legacy Symposium
honors.description: The Autonomous Indoor Mapping System was a senior design project selected to represent the Electrical and Computer Engineer department at Saint Louis University''s Legacy Symposium.
honors.issuer: Issued by Saint Louis University · May 2015

honors.title: Recipient of Buick Achievers Scholarship
honors.description: The Buick Achievers Scholarship Program wants to reward students who have succeeded both inside and outside of the classroom—and who may not be able to attend college without financial assistance. It's a reward for what you've made of yourself and the difference you are making for others. - http://www.buickachievers.com/guidelines/

projects.title: Electrical and Computer Engineering Senior Design
projects.description:
•	Worked with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) and two other Electrical and Computer Engineering students on an autonomous robotic 3D room mapping project.
•	Developed a system in C to capture depth images with a Microsoft Kinect and Linux GumStix and transmit data via TCP/IP over Wi-Fi to a central server.
•	Created an image processing program ran on the server that analyzes the images and transmit instructions for robotic movement using C++ and OpenCV.

projects.title: Saint Louis University Robotics
projects.description:
•	Represented Saint Louis University at IEEE R5 Robotic competitions.
•	Designed, built and tested robots to solve problems as designed by the IEEE committee. 
•	Organized team responsibilities based on skills in order to best produce a working robot.
•	Analyzed team contributions and provided assistance as necessary.
